content: this is a summary of a legal case that took place in the klaipėda district court the court heard a divorce case between two parties the plaintiff requested various things including the retention of her surname custody of the children child support division of property and compensation for nonpecuniary damages the defendant also sought the dissolution of the marriage custody of the children child support division of property and compensation for improvements made to the property both parties presented their arguments and evidence the court upheld part of the plaintiffs claims and part of the defendants counterclaim the court awarded the plaintiff monetary compensation for nonpecuniary damages and decided that the dissolution of the marriage was the fault of both parties the court now needs to determine how to divide the property acquired during the marriage the court will consider the evidence provided by both parties and determine the ownership of assets such as vehicles and tools the court also addressed the payment of costs and stamp duty in the case the courts decision is enforceable immediately but can be appealed the court has dissolved the marriage and awarded specific assets to each party the defendant has been ordered to pay financial compensation to the plaintiff for the vehicles awarded to her the defendant has also been awarded various tools and equipment the court dismissed the remaining parts of the application and counterclaim the defendant has been ordered to pay the plaintiffs costs and legal translation costs the plaintiff has been exempted from paying stamp duty both parties have been ordered to pay the costs of serving procedural documents
